description: Victorian Serious Road Casualties (TAC) is a dataset listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Accident Commission. As the statutory insurer of third-party personal liability for road crashes, the TAC funds treatment and support services for people injured in road crashes in Victoria. The number of hospitalised TAC claimants is shown to be a rigorous and consistent measure of serious injury for road safety strategies in Victoria (D'elia A. and S. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Accident Commission. Its tags are TAC, Transport Accident Commission, claims, hospitalised, no fault compensation. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
